steps.en: Install one plugin by name from the Cursor chat (or Settings → Plugins)
steps.zh: 在 Cursor 对话里按名字装一个插件（或去设置的插件页）

steps.en: Cursor reads the plugin's manifest and registers its skills, rules, subagents, hooks and MCP servers
steps.zh: 读插件清单，注册 skill、规则、子 agent、hook 和 MCP

steps.en: Do the one-time setup it asks for: a vendor sign-in, or pstack's model picker
steps.zh: 做一次它要的设置：连接器走厂商登录，pstack 选模型

steps.en: Start a task through the plugin's entry point, or just ask
steps.zh: 从插件的入口命令开始任务，或者照常提需求

steps.en: The agent follows the plugin's playbook or calls the vendor's MCP tools; hooks fire on stop and after edits
steps.zh: agent 按剧本干活或调厂商 MCP 工具；hook 按事件触发

value.en: Cursor-maintained workflows and SaaS connectors land with one command — no hand-written manifests, MCP URLs or OAuth plumbing
value.zh: 一条命令装上 Cursor 维护的工作流和 SaaS 连接器，不用手写清单、MCP 地址和 OAuth 接线
